synthetic_chat_specificity.description: Scaled shared-factor decoupling benchmark for paired base/fine-tuned activation streams. Paper-reported anchors: Table 1 false fine-tuned-only rates and Table 4 fine-tuned-only candidate counts; remaining alignment fields are benchmark analogues used to score the scaled synthetic setting.
synthetic_chat_specificity.notes: The benchmark uses fewer candidates than the paper's 73,728-candidate Gemma setting, so raw candidate counts are scale anchors rather than expected exact matches. The paper reports aggregate validation FVE, not separate base/chat FVE.

fraction_top_norm_scaling_specific.description: Rewards top fine-tuned-specific candidates whose reconstruction and residual evidence indicate genuine stream-specific structure.

fraction_top_norm_true_chat.description: Rewards top fine-tuned-specific candidates aligned to held-out true fine-tuned-only concept directions.

fraction_top_norm_weak_or_shared.description: Penalizes top fine-tuned-specific candidates aligned to weak shared or fully shared concept directions.

chat_only_latent_count.description: Penalizes excessive fine-tuned-only candidate labels so methods cannot win by over-marking candidates as specific.

false_ft_only_rate_pi06.description: Penalizes fine-tuned-only candidate labels whose independent evidence fails the pi=0.6 specificity check.

reconstruction_fve.description: Rewards aggregate fraction of variance explained across both paired activation streams.

base_reconstruction_fve.description: Rewards reconstruction quality on the base activation stream to catch one-sided reconstruction shortcuts.

chat_reconstruction_fve.description: Rewards reconstruction quality on the chat activation stream to catch one-sided reconstruction shortcuts.

mean_l0.description: Penalizes denser candidate activations so specificity gains cannot come only from using many more active factors.

synthetic_complete_shrinkage.description: Scaled complete-shrinkage benchmark: weak concepts present in both streams can be misidentified as fine-tuned-only when stream-specific evidence is measured naively.
synthetic_complete_shrinkage.notes: The benchmark uses fewer candidates than the paper's 73,728-candidate Gemma setting, so raw candidate counts are scale anchors rather than expected exact matches. The paper reports aggregate validation FVE, not separate base/chat FVE.
